    How often do you treat lawns in Gonzales?

    Our annual lawn program includes seasonal planned visits, generally about six weeks apart. Timing and applications depend on the season, weather, and turf condition. Each visit has a purpose; eight visits do not mean eight identical fertilizer applications.

    How does your monthly billing work?

    The annual year-round lawn program price is divided into twelve monthly payments. Monthly billing does not mean a treatment every month. Service is month-to-month with no long-term contract. Your estimate explains the property’s price, service scope, and terms before you approve.

    Is weed control included with fertilization?

    Yes. The lawn program includes seasonally timed pre-emergents for prevention and targeted post-emergents for existing weeds. Product selection depends on the grass, weed species, weather, and label directions. Some persistent weeds require continued management or additional targeted treatment.

    Which grass types do you treat?

    We work with the warm-season grasses common in Gonzales, including centipede, St. Augustine, Bermuda, and zoysia. Nutrition and weed-control choices are adjusted for the turf and site conditions. If you do not know your grass type, tell us and we can help identify the next step.

    Follow the instructions provided with that visit. Watering and mowing timing depend on the products applied and the conditions. If you are unsure, contact our office before changing the aftercare plan.

real_faqs.q: Do you serve Geismar, Dutchtown, and Sorrento?
real_faqs.a: Yes. Our nearby service area includes Gonzales, Geismar, Dutchtown, Sorrento, St. Amant, and Prairieville. We confirm service availability using your address, so send your property details for a coverage check and estimate.

real_faqs.q: Do I need to be home for treatment?
real_faqs.a: Usually not, as long as we have access to the scheduled treatment area. Please unlock gates, secure pets, and share any access restrictions or sensitive areas. We provide service notes and aftercare directions following the visit.

real_faqs.q: When can children and pets return to the lawn?
real_faqs.a: Keep people and pets away from the treatment area during application. Follow the specific re-entry directions provided for the products used. A single waiting period does not apply to every treatment.

real_faqs.q: Should I water or mow after an application?
real_faqs.a: Follow the instructions provided with that visit. Watering and mowing timing depend on the products applied and the conditions. If you are unsure, contact our office before changing the aftercare plan.

real_faqs.q: Will fertilizer fix yellow grass or bare spots?
real_faqs.a: Not always. Shade, moisture, mowing, insects, disease, and soil conditions can affect the lawn. Tell us what you are seeing so we can review the cause and recommend an appropriate next step. Fertilizer cannot revive dead grass or correct drainage problems by itself.

real_faqs.q: Can I add flower-bed or fire ant service?
real_faqs.a: Yes. These are separate services that can be included in your estimate or added to your plan. We will explain the scope and price. Seasonal insect and disease care within the regular lawn program follows that program’s scope; additional targeted care is reviewed when needed.
